title: hirculus ranunculoides subsp. alpina
intro: Hirculus ranunculoides subsp. alpina, commonly known as Alpine Buttercup, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the genus Hirculus, native to mountainous regions in Europe. This plant is used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antispasmodic properties, and is said to aid in soothing respiratory issues and skin irritations. The therapeutic actions of Alpine Buttercup include its ability to reduce pain, calm the nervous system, and promote wound healing, due to the presence of bioactive constituents such as alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins. However, further research is needed to confirm the exact health benefits and therapeutic actions of Hirculus ranunculoides subsp. alpina.
